annotations.title: Convert structural framing (beams) and columns from a linked

description: Convert structural framing (beams) and columns from a linked IFC model into native Revit structural framing/column instances, matching detected section sizes to family types. Supports dry-run preview, batched creation, section-based column base-type selection (steel / SHS / RC), and optional alignment of column tops to the floor bottom above.

alignColumnTopsToFloorBottom.description: Align created column tops to the bottom of the floor above, detected by ray/geometry probing.

apply.description: Actually create the native elements. When false the tool behaves as a preview.

autoColumnBaseType.description: Auto-select the column base family type per detected section instead of always using baseColumnType.

baseColumnType.description: Base family type name used as the column template.

baseFramingType.description: Base family type name used as the framing template.

baseRcColumnType.description: Base family type used for RC (rectangular concrete) columns.

baseShsColumnType.description: Base family type used for square-hollow-section (SHS) columns.

baseSteelColumnType.description: Base family type used for steel (H / wide-flange) columns.

batchSize.description: Number of elements created per transaction batch.

columnCategory.description: Override the IFC category treated as columns.

dryRun.description: Preview only; analyse and report without modifying the model.

framingCategory.description: Override the IFC category treated as framing.

includeColumns.description: Include structural columns in the sync.

includeFraming.description: Include structural framing (beams) in the sync.

linkInstanceId.description: ElementId of the linked IFC model instance to read structural elements from.

maxColumnTopSearchDistanceMm.description: Maximum upward search distance (mm) when aligning column tops to the floor bottom.

maxColumns.description: Cap the number of columns processed (omit / 0 for no cap).

maxFraming.description: Cap the number of framing members processed (omit / 0 for no cap).

minLengthMm.description: Ignore framing shorter than this length (mm).

replaceExisting.description: Replace native elements previously created by a prior sync.

shsColumnMinSizeMm.description: Minimum square size (mm) for a section to be classified as SHS.

shsSquareToleranceMm.description: Width/depth tolerance (mm) used when deciding if a section is square (SHS).

sizeRoundMm.description: Rounding granularity (mm) applied when matching section sizes to family types.

sourceTagPrefix.description: Prefix written to Mark / Comments to tag synced elements by their IFC source.
